children: Whale Technorevenant sold 175,819 HYPE for about $10.98 million and used $6.85 million to repay a USDC loan on HyperCore. According to Odaily, excluding forced liquidations, Technorevenant was the largest seller on Hyperliquid’s spot market over the past 24 hours; the repayment lowered the loan’s liquidation price to $49.30. Most of the sales took place as HYPE perpetual-contract liquidations peaked and the token’s price reached a period low.

title: Whale Technorevenant Sells 175,819 HYPE for $10.98M, Uses $6.85M to Repay USDC Loan
